title: When Kumo's paused
summary: A wake-up comes due just as Kumo's model reaches its plan's usage limit. Background work pauses until the limit resets, shown at once as a problem that says when; nothing is retried meanwhile. When it resets, Kumo catches up once on what it missed and tells you in one message, and the problem clears.

problems.detail: Your plan's usage limit was reached, so wake-ups and mail wait until it resets. Then Kumo catches up once, and tells you in one message what it missed.
problems.fix: Nothing to do: Kumo picks up on its own. To go on sooner, add usage to your plan; Kumo starts again as soon as a message in the chat goes through.
